verdict.rationale: Hightouch Identity Resolution writes unified identities and a one-row-per-identity Golden Record table into the customer's warehouse, and the docs say these can be queried directly or used to build models (docs-8, docs-9, docs-43). Hightouch Events also lands behavioral events in the warehouse (docs-5). That makes the warehouse a documented profile store, but the docs say Hightouch does not store or serve profiles itself (docs-17, docs-40), and its REST API covers only syncs, models, sources and destinations (docs-13, supp-openapi-spec). Missing for 10: a documented profile lookup API, an explicit joined profile view of traits plus identifiers plus event history, and documentation of the identity-resolution output table schema.
